nodes.claim: Literal fixed-reference flow, rate, >= threshold hitting and finite/stopped record recursion.
Joint Borel flow/rate/reflection, integrated hazard and crossing; finite continuous nonnegative rate along each arc, differentiable hazard, joint Borel density and guarded finite constructors.
For each fixed state, the positive finite waiting measure on Ioc(0,T) is rho_z(s) ds; it has total mass<=1 without normalizing away infinity.
At deterministic depth n, actual complete finite stopped history H_n and unchanged entire raw unused tail Y_n have joint law mu_n product P; coordinate0 of Y_n is source E_(n+1).

For admissible d,F,A, strict finite-clock guards/test observables and history/time integrands are jointly Borel on whole carriers. Lebesgue time measure is sigma-finite; parameter section integrals are measurable.

At each fixed h, restrict the deterministic Ioc(0,d(h)) density law by Iio(d(h)); evaluate arbitrary Borel time sections/nonnegative tests and obtain exact strict finite fiber law and mass<=1, stopped0.

Unnormalized actual fixed-depth joint finite next-wait density for all Borel history events, all finite Borel history cutoffs and all jointly Borel nonnegative history/time tests; Borel finite subprobability kernel on all histories.
Iterate conditional jump density with the final survival factor over ordered event times, recover prescribed path functional, sum over counts and justify full A.7.

Actual construction and joint Borel maps with admissible deterministic tests give measurable guarded integrands.

route_semantics: One sufficient conjunctive route. Independent histories may not be invented. The existing survival88 edge and a finite-atom-null lemma are not false AND parents of the strict restricted density target.

test_class.A: Any Borel A subset of Hist_n; no positive history-law mass requirement.
test_class.d: Every fixed deterministic Borel map d:Hist_n->NNReal. Each d(h) is finite, but d need not be bounded across histories. d(H_n) can be random. There is no omega/tail argument and no external random function d.
test_class.F: Every jointly Borel nonnegative extended test F:Hist_n x NNReal -> ENNReal, including indicator tests of arbitrary Borel joint history/time sets. Nonnegative extended tests require no integrability provider; results may be infinity. A bounded real signed test is a later corollary requiring its internally derived integrability, not an extra standing source hypothesis.
test_class.classification: Source-implicit admissible measurable test interface, not pure typing and not seventh/eighth analytic premises. Joint measurability cannot be replaced by separately measurable sections alone.
test_class.tail_restriction: F and d inspect only the complete deterministic-depth history and a supplied prospective finite time s. They cannot inspect the unused threshold or future input sequence.
test_class.constructor: On a live last record (T,z) and positive finite prospective wait s, the prescribed next record is live(T+s,S(Phi_s z)); appending it to h is the finite next-history constructor. Its joint Borel property is derived from A.2 maps and finite-product/tag operations. Stopped histories have no next phase; the finite-density measure is zero there. Future F may compose with this Borel constructor to represent actual ordered-time integrands without a constructor-law provider.
